Written by Jeremy Yan | 01/26/2026

Great news! If you’re applying for EB2 NIW green card without an advanced degree at the moment, you may use your years of work experience to make it happen.

That said, your immigration lawyer may tell you that you may need an Expert Opinion Letter to show USCIS that you have the US equivalence of an advanced degree.

But what's an Expert Opinion Letter (EOL)?

This article is to break everything down for you if you have any questions about the EB2 NIW Expert Opinion Letter.

Founded by an immigrant just like you, AET knows your struggles. So read on the 8 key things to know for your EB2 NIW Expert Opinion Letter.

1. What is an EB-2 NIW Expert Opinion Letter?

Expert Opinion Letter (EOL), aka Professional Experience Evaluation, is written by university professors or experts to pair your relevant professional experience with academic coursework to determine a U.S. degree equivalency.

It's widely used for Eb1a, Eb2-NIW, H1B (or H1B RFE), TN-Visa and other immigration related cases.

You may have to request this service if you didn't finsh a four-year higher education program in your home country but have many years of work experience in your field.

USCIS needs this as proof that you have a US equivalent advanced degree.

If you're looking for a trusted credential evaluation company, please contact us today for a Free Estimate.

2. Why do you need EB-2 NIW Expert Opinion Letter?

According to USCIS, you are required to have at least an advanced degree or its equivalent for an EB-2 NIW visa.

Therefore, you may need an EB2-NIW Expert Opinion Letter to showcase the evidence that you either have a U.S advanced degree or that your foreign degree plus years of work experience is equivalent to a particular U.S degree.

3. How to get Expert Opinion Letters for EB-2 NIW?

Typically, you may want to go with a trusted Expert Opinion Letter agency that's specialized in immigration-related cases.

This organization should have a good understanding of educational systems worldwide and can accurately translate your foreign degrees with work experience into a U.S. equivalent.

5. Documents for EB-2 NIW Expert Opinion Letters

Before you start the process of evaluating your credentials, you may need the following documents for the EB-2 NIW Expert Opinion Letter:

  • Degree Certificate or Diploma
  • Translated degree certificate by a certified translator
  • Resume and Employment Verification Letters if possible
  • Transcript and its certied English translation (can be supporting documents)

6. What does an EB-2 NIW Expert Opinion Letter include?

An Expert Opinion Letter for EB-2 NIW usually includes:

  • Introduction: Explanation of the purpose of the letter; A statement identifying the expert, their qualifications, and their relationship to the petitioner.
  • Expert’s Qualifications: Detailed description of the expert’s background, including academic credentials, professional experience, and any relevant accomplishments or recognition.
  • Petitioner’s (Your) Background: Description of the petitioner’s specific work, projects, research contribution, and more.
  • National Interest Criteria: Explanation of why the petitioner’s work is of substantial intrinsic merit.
  • Examples: Specific examples of the impact and importance of the petitioner’s work.
  • Conclusion: A summary reiterating the key points made in the letter; A clear statement supporting the approval of the NIW petition.

8. EB-2 NIW Expert Opinion Letter Process Time

Between 3 and 21 business days.

Depending on which Expert Opinion Letter service you go with, processing time for EB-2 NIW Expert Opinion Letters is from 3 to 21 business days.
